// The 3D Gielis supershape: the spherical product of two superformula curves,
// Longitudinal swept once around and Latitudinal from pole to pole. Reuses the
// plane curve's six parameters per factor rather than restating them
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Superformula).
type Superformula3D
    implements IParametricSurface
{
    Longitudinal: Superformula2D;
    Latitudinal: Superformula2D;
}
